yellow sprinklesLine a tray with baking paper and slice the bananas into thick coins.Mix the yoghurt and honey.Dip each coin, then roll half in crushed peanuts and half in sprinkles.Freeze on the tray crumbed chicken tendersThe lab under Gru's houseHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken tenderloins in a crunchy parmesan and panko crumb, baked golden, with honey mustard, tomato sauce and a crisp potato wedge pile.Heat the oven to 220°C.Cut 1kg potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, paprika and salt, and roast for 35 minutes.Dip 800g chicken tenderloins in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 150g
